title: Juicy Yeasty Indian Cheese Paratha
description: A creamy and yeasty Indian dish featuring shredded Mexican cheese, perfect for a brunch mood, made with fry-grind-rice-khao-khua and no onion or garlic, in the form of a paratha.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine warm flour, yeast, salt, and sugar, and mix well.
Gradually add water to the mixture and knead for 5 minutes to form a smooth dough.
Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let it rest in a warm place for 1 hour.
Divide the dough into 4 equal portions and roll each portion into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 6 inches in diameter.
Place a quarter of the shredded cheese and a quarter of the fried and ground khao khuay in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle or a square shape, and press the edges together to seal.
Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat and cook the parathas for 2 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Brush the parathas with ghee and serve hot.
